title.zh: SoFi tie-up shows stablecoins can provide alternative blockchain settlement rail
title.en: SoFi tie-up shows stablecoins can provide alternative blockchain settlement rail

current_state.zh: SoFi began settling its debit and credit card transactions with Mastercard using its SoFiUSD stablecoin, migrating an entire card program expected to process more than $25 billion in annualized volume onto blockchain-based settlement rails.
current_state.en: SoFi began settling its debit and credit card transactions with Mastercard using its SoFiUSD stablecoin, migrating an entire card program expected to process more than $25 billion in annualized volume onto blockchain-based settlement rails.
